diversePool: A cartographer maps a city that redraws itself every midnight.
Rival chefs duel using recipes that rewrite customers memories.
A lighthouse keeper trades storm warnings for forbidden star charts.
Underground postal workers smuggle truths inside undeliverable letters.
A museum night guard catalogs artifacts that refuse to stay in frames.
Two chess prodigies discover the board predicts real wars one move early.
A ferry only appears for passengers who have forgotten their own names.
Beekeepers harvest rumors from hives that buzz in human languages.
An archivist must delete tomorrow headlines to keep yesterday stable.
Street musicians tune instruments that open doors to parallel alleys.
A park ranger tags animals that migrate between video-game save states.
Clockmakers repair timepieces that steal hours from their owners sleep.
repetitiveBase: A hero finds a mysterious artifact that grants power but corrupts them
defaultPrompt: Generate distinct game-loop or story premises. Each idea must be a single concrete sentence.
template: In a world where {noun} control {domain}, a {role} must {verb} the last {macguffin}.
